user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface websites in search results in ChatGPT search features.
user_agents.scope: ChatGPT search features; opted-out sites may still appear as navigational links.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow OAI-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validate safety of web pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.
user_agents.scope: Only visits web pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content for training generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Crawls web content used to train generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GPTBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Execute user-initiated actions in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs.
user_agents.scope: Visits web pages when users ask questions or interact via GPT Actions.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt rules may not apply because actions are user-initiated.

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content that could contribute to training generative AI models.
user_agents.scope: Public web content gathered for model development and training datasets.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a Disallow directive for ClaudeBot in your robots.txt file.

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Accesses websites when individuals ask questions to Claude.
user_agents.scope: User-initiated requests to retrieve web content in response to a user query.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a Disallow directive for Claude-User in your robots.txt file.

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Navigates the web to improve search result quality for users.
user_agents.scope: Analyzes online content to enhance the relevance and accuracy of search responses.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a Disallow directive for Claude-SearchBot in your robots.txt file.

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Find information for building Google's search indexes and analysis.
user_agents.scope: Google Search, Discover, Google Images, Video mode, and Google News.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under user-agent Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot Smartphone
user_agents.purpose: Find information for building Google's search indexes on mobile.
user_agents.scope: Google Search and other products.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under user-agent Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot Desktop
user_agents.purpose: Find information for building Google's search indexes on desktop.
user_agents.scope: Google Search and other products.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under user-agent Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Crawl images, logos, and favicons.
user_agents.scope: Google Images, Discover, Video mode, and Google Search features.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under Googlebot-Image or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Crawl video content.
user_agents.scope: Video-related Google Search features and other products dependent on videos.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under Googlebot-Video or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content for Google News.
user_agents.scope: Google News product including news.google.com and the Google News app.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under Googlebot-News or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Crawl pages for shopping surfaces.
user_agents.scope: All surfaces of Google Shopping.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under user-agent Storebot-Google.

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Crawl for testing tools like Rich Result Test and URL inspection.
user_agents.scope: Search testing tools in Search Console.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under Google-InspectionTool or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Generic crawler for internal research, development, and product teams.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible content across sites; does not affect specific products.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under user-agent GoogleOther.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Fetch publicly accessible image URLs.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible image URLs; does not affect specific products.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under GoogleOther-Image or GoogleOther.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Fetch publicly accessible video URLs.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible video URLs; does not affect specific products.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under GoogleOther-Video or GoogleOther.

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls requested by site owners for building Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.scope: Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under Google-CloudVertexBot or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Google-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls content usage for Gemini model training and grounding.
user_agents.scope: Gemini Apps, Vertex AI API for Gemini, and Grounding with Google Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under user-agent Google-Extended.

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Gathers and indexes web information to deliver search experience.

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Gathers and indexes web information to deliver search experience.

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Powers search technology across Apple products and services, and collects training data.
user_agents.scope: Web crawl and rendering for Apple ecosystem search including Spotlight, Siri, and Safari.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot in robots.txt file, or use noindex meta tag.

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls use of crawled content to train generative foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Determines how to use data crawled by Applebot; does not crawl webpages.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot-Extended in robots.txt file.

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.scope: URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.opt_out: Does not follow robots.txt.

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawls shared content on Meta apps to display title, description, and thumbnail image.
user_agents.scope: Content shared on Meta apps like Facebook, Instagram, or Messenger.
user_agents.opt_out: Add disallow in robots.txt; might bypass for security/integrity checks.

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Navigates the web to improve Meta AI search result quality.
user_agents.scope: Online web content to enhance relevance and accuracy of Meta AI.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Improves advertising and other business-related products and services.
user_agents.scope: Web content for advertising and business-related products and services.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Trains foundation AI models or improves products by indexing content directly.
user_agents.scope: Web content for training foundation AI models and direct indexing.
user_agents.opt_out: Add disallow for crawler in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetches individual links at user request and evaluates agentic AI capabilities.
user_agents.scope: User-requested links and agentic AI task completion.
user_agents.opt_out: May bypass robots.txt rules as it performs user-requested fetches.

user_agents.name: Bingbot
user_agents.purpose: Indexes web pages for Bing search and Microsoft services.
user_agents.scope: Crawls public web content across the internet for general search indexing.
user_agents.opt_out: Block Bingbot using standard robots.txt disallow rules.

user_agents.name: MicrosoftPreview
user_agents.purpose: Retrieves web content to power Microsoft Copilot and rich previews.
user_agents.scope: Crawls web pages to provide content retrieval and summaries for Copilot.
user_agents.opt_out: Block MicrosoftPreview using robots.txt disallow rules.

user_agents.name: BingPreview
user_agents.purpose: Generates snapshots and previews of web pages.
user_agents.scope: Performs real-time user-triggered page snapshots for Bing search results.
user_agents.opt_out: Block BingPreview using robots.txt disallow rules.

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Used to improve products and services and train Amazon AI models.
user_agents.scope: Host-level web pages across domain hosts.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt, or use noarchive, noindex, or rel=nofollow.

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improves search experiences in Amazon products and services without model training.
user_agents.scope: Web pages eligible to appear in search experiences like Alexa.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt disallow directives or directives given to other search bots.

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Supports user actions by fetching live information to answer queries.
user_agents.scope: Live web information fetched on behalf of users.
user_agents.opt_out: May not follow all robots.txt directives as actions are user-initiated.

user_agents.name: CCBot
user_agents.purpose: Automated web crawler building an open copy of the internet for research and analysis.
user_agents.scope: Samples a subset of the web for researchers, companies, and individuals.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using User-agent: CCBot or join opt-out registry.
